opening_message: I own Trailhead Supply and I need a refund on a pair of Midnight Trekking Poles one of our customers bought. They arrived about 11 weeks ago and the reason is simple: not what I expected. I don't have the order number on me, so please find the order for me.
followups: The poles were sitting in the box for a while before they got opened, and they're still not what I expected. I just want the refund processed, I'm not going back and forth on this.
